[2][4]<br/><br/>**Manual kernel compilation:** Clone the Linux kernel source, configure it (using menuconfig or provided guest configs), and build either `vmlinux` (x86_64) or `Image` (aarch64). [2]<br/><br/>**Using Firecracker's recipe:** The `./tools/devtool build_ci_artifacts kernels` command builds pre-configured kernels. Currently supported versions are 5.10, 5.10-no-acpi, and 6.1. [2]<br/><br/>**Rootfs creation:** Build an ext4 filesystem image using `dd` and `mkfs.ext4`, then mount and populate it (commonly using Alpine Linux with OpenRC init system).
